description: Validate one VideoSpec against the paired template contract and return local source for the chosen framework, or switch an existing project's framework. For a VideoSpec template in Remotion or HyperFrames, use prepare_video_template with the VideoSpec. Never infer a framework from creative wording; omit framework unless the user chose one or said no preference, and ask the user on needs-selection. Continue with the returned project: edit project.spec, then call again to regenerate or to switch frameworks. A rejected field is unsupported in both frameworks; fix it rather than dropping it. The tool returns local source and commands; it does not render, save or upload.

framework.description: Only supply an explicit user choice. Omit for an ambiguous request or to inherit the existing project framework.

project.description: The latest project returned by this tool, with any edits made to project.spec. Caller-held, not a saved hosted project.

spec.description: A VideoSpec 1.0 document for a new project.

name: prepare_video_template
title: Prepare a template video in Remotion or HyperFrames
